line: Invited only to set the pace, Grete Waitz wasn't expected to finish. She won.
Luck? Work hard and prepare properly. Some day your chance may come.
A sleepy pupil grabbed green wood at the last minute. Next morning: no fire.
Your dry wood? Steady the body, senses and mind, before problems start.
Train the body, and it grows strong and sturdy, ready for any task.
credit: Musonius Rufus · On Training, tr. Lutz

line: The mind? In studies, slow breathing went with feeling calmer, yet more awake.
credit: Zaccaro et al. · Front Hum Neurosci, 2018

line: Holding the senses steady is yoga. But yoga comes and goes, so stay alert.
Caring for the body? Never skip a small gain. Small things gathered become great.
Same practice daily? Dull, you may say. Not hard, if you're full of energy.
credit: Shunryu Suzuki · Zen Mind, Beginner's Mind

line: Ashtanga makes Willem Dafoe feel strong inside and out. Tomorrow morning, gather dry wood.
